text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Production quality checks tripped for /v1/generate. 18% of recent responses failing schema/encoding guards. Spike begins at ~1918123400, correlated with deploy of model 'redwood-13b-q4v3' (deploy id d-20260315-9). Logging sample attached.

alex: acked. I'm oncall. Pulling logs now.

meera: looks like an encoding/byte-order mismatch — some tokens are coming back with unexpected high-byte sequences, causing downstream JSON parse errors in customers that validate outputs. Could be tokenizer variant or a build that picked the wrong tokenizer files.

alex: past canary checks were green at 1918123000. Deploy-bot shows rollout to 10% then to 50% ~1918123300.

ops-lead: tagging this as a P1. Paging oncall and eng-runtime. If tokenizer mismatch suspected, we should flip the feature flag to pin previous model or kill new rollout. Meera, want to confirm runbook?

meera: runbook says: 1) stop further rollout 2) flip model-router to previous model bundle 3) disable auto-weight-update.

alex: stopping rollout now. (running)

deploy-bot: Command received: deploy halt d-20260315-9 -> status: accepted.

alex: halted propagation at 1918123552. Confirmed no new nodes pulling weights.

meera: I'm seeing tokenizer names mismatch in the manifest. New bundle references tokenizer v2b-utf8 while runtime expects v2a. That would cause different byte->token mapping. Example log excerpt:

```
WARN  runtime::tokenize - tokenizer mismatch: expected v2a, loaded v2b-utf8 from /mnt/models/redwood-13b-q4v3/tokenizer.json
ERROR api::response - failed output validation: invalid utf8 sequence at position 342
```

alex: yikes. That will scramble token indices for certain byte sequences. Customer-facing validation would fail for strict JSON outputs.

ops-lead: Two mitigation paths: A) roll back to previous model bundle redwood-13b-q4v2 (fast), B) patch tokenizer on new bundle and re-deploy after full canary (slower). Recommend rollback for immediate impact reduction.

meera: agree. Rolling back now to redwood-13b-q4v2 on all traffic.

alex: running router pin command: `rwctl route set --model default-model --version redwood-13b-q4v2 --reason "encoding regression rollback"`

deploy-bot: Router update accepted. Traffic shift started at 1918123618.

alex: running smoke tests. Canary call to /v1/generate with strict JSON output set.

meera: sample smoke result looks clean for 20 requests. No UTF8 errors.

sam-support-bot: FYI CS: we have ~12 customers who reported parse errors in the last 30 minutes; highest priority account flagged was invoice-service-inc. They saw truncated invoice JSONs. Need comms.

ops-lead: @sam-support-bot please open an incident support ticket and send initial comms: short note acknowledging issue + mitigation and ETA for postmortem.

sam-support-bot: ticket created: INC-5298. Initial comms draft: "We identified an encoding regression after a model rollout; we've reverted to the previous stable model and are investigating root cause. We'll follow up with a timeline and mitigation steps." Ready to send after approvers.

jordan: hopping in for handoff. I'm next oncall starting 1918123800. Summary: deploy of redwood-13b-q4v3 caused tokenizer mismatch leading to output encoding errors. Rollback to q4v2 completed and smoke tests OK. Impact: ~18% failing checks, ~12 affected customers, none reported data exfiltration or downtime beyond failed parses. Actions remaining: gather manifest diffs, reproduce locally, confirm no residual traffic to bad bundle, produce timeline for postmortem.

alex: confirmed router shows 100% traffic to q4v2 at 1918123684. No nodes still serving q4v3.

meera: I'll collect manifests and raise a PR to ensure model packaging includes tokenizer hash verification in CI.

ops-lead: nice coordinated response. Jordan, take lead on the incident handoff doc and postmortem. Please include: timeline, customer impact, root cause (tokenizer file mismatch), fix plan (CI tokenizer-hash check + deployment gate), and preventive changes (alerts for validation-failure spike during rollouts).

jordan: will do. Adding runbook link and assigning postmortem owner.

incident-bot: Incident marked RESOLVED -> mitigation in place, rollback complete. Postmortem requested.

alex: handing to jordan for final write-up and PM followups.

jordan: thanks — creating postmortem stub now. I'll close out after meera's artifact collection and support message sent.

sam-support-bot: initial customer notifications sent for impacted accounts at 1918123704.

ops-lead: great. Follow-up: schedule a model packaging audit and a short retro in eng-runtime tomorrow. Good job team. :thumbsup:
